def caught(sig,frame):
 os.write(1,b'child-int\n');os._exit(7)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT,caught)
signal.alarm(8)
print('CHILD-READY',flush=True)
while True:signal.pause()

cases.script:
trap 'printf "CHLD\n" >> chld' CHLD
/usr/bin/python3 background.py & bg=$!
timeout 5 /usr/bin/python3 waiter.py "$bg"; rc=$?
printf "timeout-return\n" >> events
printf "timeout=%s\n" "$rc"
wait "$bg"; printf "background=%s\n" "$?"
[[ -s chld ]] && echo chld=observed || echo chld=missing
trap - CHLD
remaining=$(jobs -p); [[ -z $remaining ]] && echo jobs=empty || echo jobs=present
rm -f chld bg-exit

files.waiter.py:
import os,pathlib,sys,time
pid=int(sys.argv[1]);deadline=time.monotonic()+3
while True:
 try:state=pathlib.Path('/proc/%d/stat'%pid).read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()[0]
 except FileNotFoundError:state='gone'
 if pathlib.Path('bg-exit').exists() and state in ('Z','gone'):break
 if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('background job did not finish first')
 time.sleep(.01)
with open('events','a') as f:f.write('timeout-child-exit\n')
raise SystemExit(3)
